# Per Mar Security Services

> > Per Mar Security Services provides comprehensive security solutions for residential and commercial properties, including 24/7 monitoring, alarm systems, video surveillance, and access control across the Midwest.

Per Mar Security Services is a Five Diamond Certified security provider offering integrated solutions for homes and businesses. Their services span alarm monitoring, live video surveillance, access control, fire detection, security cameras, and specialized offerings like medical alerts and loss prevention.

## Key Topics

- 24/7 Alarm Monitoring
- Live Video Monitoring

- Fire Alarms & Detection

## Business Security Solutions

- [Business Security Overview](https://www.permarsecurity.com/business): Business security solutions overview including monitoring, alarms, and access control
- [Live Video Monitoring](https://www.permarsecurity.com/business/live-video-monitoring): 24/7 live video monitoring service for commercial security and threat detection
- [Alarm Monitoring](https://www.permarsecurity.com/business/alarm-monitoring): Five Diamond Certified 24/7 alarm monitoring with AI surveillance integration
- [Security Camera Systems](https://www.permarsecurity.com/business/security-cameras): 1080p HD security camera systems with cloud storage for commercial surveillance
- [Access Control](https://www.permarsecurity.com/business/access-control): Cloud-based access control with biometric security and multi-site management
- [Burglary Alarm Systems](https://www.permarsecurity.com/business/burglary-alarm-systems): Commercial burglary alarm systems with motion sensors and access control
- [Fire Alarms & Smoke Detectors](https://www.permarsecurity.com/business/fire-alarms-smoke-detectors): NFPA 72 compliant fire alarm and smoke detector systems for businesses

## Security Personnel & Patrol Services

- [Security Guard Services](https://www.permarsecurity.com/business/security-guard-services): Uniformed security officers with Per Mar University training for events and patrols
- [Mobile Patrol](https://www.permarsecurity.com/business/mobile-patrol): SecurePatrol vehicle patrols with GPS tracking and 24/7 dispatch services
- [Loss Prevention](https://www.permarsecurity.com/business/loss-prevention): Retail loss prevention with camera monitoring and theft prevention strategies
- [Temporary Security Rentals](https://www.permarsecurity.com/business/temporary-security-rentals): Mobile video surveillance trailers and temporary alarm systems for construction sites

- [Residential Security Overview](https://www.permarsecurity.com/residential): Residential security solutions including alarms, cameras, and home automation

- [Home Automation](https://www.permarsecurity.com/residential/home-automation): Z-Wave smart home control with video doorbells, locks, and thermostat automation
- [Environmental Monitoring](https://www.permarsecurity.com/residential/environmental-monitoring): Water leak, temperature, and carbon monoxide detection with emergency alerts
